description: Send a requirement to Colophon (Licensing images, footage, music, fonts or patents; Translation and localization by language pair and field). It is recorded and answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read the request's status (request_status), to add details later (continuation), and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing; nothing is bought until an offer's exact terms are accepted.

contact.description: Optional; stored apart from the requirement, kept while we correspond or do business and for 24 months after, then deleted; you can ask us to delete it sooner (a service may state a different period on its page)

continuation.description: The receipt id and token of an earlier request, to add to it instead of opening a new one

specifications.description: Fields from the service's request schema

name: submit_request
title: Send a requirement
